# Agent Files JP Mirror Sync Rules

When editing `plugins/{name}/agents/*.md`, **always update `*.jp.md` in the same commit**.

## Overview

Links agent files and their JP mirrors under `plugins/{name}/agents/`.
Ensures that when an agent file is edited, its JP mirror is updated in the same commit.

## Related Files

| File path | Role |
|---|---|
| `plugins/*/agents/*.md` | English agent file (auto-loaded by Claude) |
| `plugins/*/agents/*.jp.md` | JP mirror (human reference only) |

## When Editing

When editing any agent file, always update the JP mirror in the same commit:

- [ ] Changes in `*.md` are reflected in the corresponding `*.jp.md` in Japanese
- [ ] Section structure of `*.jp.md` matches the English `*.md`
- [ ] `*.jp.md` starts with the JP mirror warning comment (`<!-- This file is a Japanese mirror... -->`)

## JP Mirror Warning Comment

All JP mirror files (`*.jp.md`) must have the following warning comment immediately after frontmatter:

```
<!-- This file is a Japanese mirror. When updating the English original, update this file too. -->
```

This comment is automatically added by `/claude-kit:mark-generated`.
When creating or editing a JP mirror manually, always confirm this comment is present.

## Rule Maintenance

When adding, deleting, or renaming agent files:
- **Added a new agent** → covered automatically by the glob (`plugins/*/agents/*.md`); no rule update needed. Do not forget to create the `*.jp.md` mirror.
- **Deleted or renamed an agent** → delete or rename the corresponding `*.jp.md` at the same time.
